searchText: Seems reasonable.. I guess we can call it "loose tight coupling" 😅 Until eth1 is fully synced BN won't be able to produce and attest to blocks, i.e. it will be in a `sync` mode It's technically the same with eth2/eth1 now, you can't produce blocks but you can still attest. Won't submitting one of the votes made by the previous proposer(s) be an option? Oh, you have to read deposits, right. That is an option that you can get away with (as long as you dont need deposits), but it's not really an "honest" thing to do.
